subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the deer herd from reference image 1, several realistic brown deer living in a peaceful sunlit forest clearing. Preserve their natural proportions, fur color, and herd behavior.

<Subject 2> is the glowing green spirit deer from reference image 2. It represents the extracted soul of one deer and must remain a luminous translucent green deer-shaped spirit with soft green particles, inner glow, and ethereal flowing energy.

<Subject 3> (S1) is the dark elf woman from reference image 3, with pale skin, long straight white hair, a black thorn-like dress, and large skeletal thorn wings. Preserve her identity, costume, wings, and cold threatening appearance. She uses black mist, shadow energy, and thorn-like dark magic.

<Subject 4> (S2) is the white light elf from reference image 5, with long pale-blonde hair, fair skin, translucent iridescent wings, and an elegant ivory-and-gold dress. Preserve her identity, clothing, wings, and sacred appearance. She uses golden-white light magic.

summary:
Create a 15-second cinematic fantasy action sequence. The opening begins in a warm sunlit forest with <Subject 1>. When <Subject 3> enters, the sunlight fades, the forest becomes dark, and thin mist spreads between the trees. All deer immediately panic and run away from <Subject 3>, fleeing deeper into the forest in the opposite direction from her. The deer closest to <Subject 3> also turns and tries to escape in the same away-from-her direction, but black mist suddenly wraps around its legs and body, immobilizing it while the other deer continue escaping. <Subject 3> extracts <Subject 2> from the trapped deer, causing the deer’s physical body to darken and lose vitality. <Subject 4> arrives, pulls <Subject 2> away from <Subject 3>, and directly absorbs the soul into her own body. After this, <Subject 4> and <Subject 3> fight in the same dark misty forest with a slightly expanded combat section. <Subject 4> ultimately defeats <Subject 3>. After being struck down, <Subject 3> emits a painful hiss and roar, then suddenly dissolves into black mist and flash-disappears in panic. Once <Subject 3> escapes, the environment transitions from dark back to bright, the fog disperses, and sunlight returns to the forest.

retention_analysis:
The opening environmental transition must be clearly visible: warm sunlight and a peaceful forest first, followed by rapidly fading sunlight, darker trees, colder color temperature, and spreading mist when <Subject 3> enters. Every deer in <Subject 1> must immediately react by running away from <Subject 3>. Their escape direction must be clearly away from her position. The nearest deer must visibly begin fleeing in that same away-from-her direction before black mist catches and restrains it. Black mist should wrap around its legs and torso and physically stop its movement while the rest of the herd continues escaping farther away from <Subject 3> and out of the clearing.

The soul extraction must be visually explicit and easy to understand. <Subject 2> must emerge from the trapped deer as a complete luminous green deer-shaped spirit. As the soul leaves, the physical deer becomes progressively darker, duller, and drained of vitality, then weakly collapses without gore.

The soul transfer into <Subject 4> must be especially clear and beautiful. Golden-white energy from <Subject 4> should seize the struggling green spirit from <Subject 3>. <Subject 2> should visibly curl and flow through streaming ribbons of green light and drifting particles toward <Subject 4>, then be drawn directly into the center of her chest. The full soul must merge into her body and disappear inside her, followed by a brief internal green-gold pulse spreading through her chest and wings. Do not show any seed artifact or any separate container.

After approximately 7 seconds, all combat remains inside a dark, lightly foggy forest with shadowy trees and enough open ground for readable full-body movement. Expand the fight moderately with several clear exchanges. Keep effects readable: black mist, thorn-like shadow trails, golden-white light arcs, impact sparks, displaced fog, leaves, and one stronger magical shockwave. During every fight beat, clearly show attack direction, contact or block, reaction, recovery, and counterattack. Avoid excessive particle density or chaotic camera movement.

<Subject 4> must clearly win the fight. <Subject 3> is struck down onto the forest ground, visibly loses the advantage, emits a painful hiss or roar, then suddenly bursts into black mist and flash-disappears in a panicked escape. After her disappearance, the blackness recedes, the fog dissolves, and the environment transitions from dark back toward a brighter, calmer forest with returning sunlight.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Cinematic live-action fantasy style. A medium-wide shot establishes a peaceful enchanted forest clearing under warm golden sunlight. <Subject 1> grazes calmly among grass and trees. <Subject 3> (S1) enters from the deeper forest. As she advances, the warm sunlight rapidly fades, shadows spread across the ground, the trees become darker, and thin cold mist rolls into the clearing. All deer immediately panic and run away from <Subject 3>, fleeing toward the far side of the clearing and deeper into the forest, clearly moving in the direction opposite her. The deer closest to <Subject 3> also turns and starts running away from her, but swirling black mist suddenly shoots forward and coils tightly around its legs and torso. The deer struggles and tries to continue running in the escape direction but is forcibly held in place while the rest of the herd keeps fleeing farther away. The camera performs a controlled Push In toward <Subject 3> and the trapped deer. <Subject 3> (S1) says coldly: <d>[Chinese] 你的魂，归我了。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot showing both <Subject 3> and the restrained deer. <Subject 3> raises one hand and pulls backward. The black mist tightens around the deer. <Subject 2> is slowly and visibly extracted from the deer’s body as a complete glowing green spiritual deer, rising upward through green light and drifting particles. The physical deer simultaneously loses its warm natural color, becoming darker, duller, and drained of vitality before collapsing weakly onto the ground. <Subject 3> draws the struggling green soul toward herself. The camera uses a slow Push In focused on the separation between the darkened physical deer and the luminous green soul.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.700, the shot cuts to a Tracking Shot as <Subject 4> (S2) rushes rapidly through the darkened forest and enters the clearing, her pale clothing and translucent wings contrasting against the black mist. She sees <Subject 3> pulling away <Subject 2> and immediately raises her hand. <Subject 4> (S2) shouts briefly: <d>[Chinese] 休想！</d> Golden-white energy streams from her hand and chest, wraps around <Subject 2>, and forcibly pulls the green soul away from <Subject 3>. The soul resists for a brief moment, then its glowing deer form begins to soften and flow inward in green ribbons and particles. The luminous soul is drawn directly into the center of <Subject 4>'s chest and disappears into her body. A brief green-gold pulse spreads through her chest and across her wings.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.300, the camera remains on both elves in a tense medium-wide shot in the dark misty forest. <Subject 3> spreads her thorn wings and attacks first with a fast sweeping black-mist slash from right to left. <Subject 4> steps diagonally aside and raises a curved golden-white light barrier to intercept it. The attack strikes the barrier with a burst of sparks and a wave of displaced fog. <Subject 4> immediately pivots forward and answers with a sharp golden light slash that drives <Subject 3> one step backward. No further spoken dialogue from this point onward.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.200, the shot cuts wider for a longer fight exchange. <Subject 3> lunges low and aggressively with twin thorn-like shadow streaks. <Subject 4> dodges the first by twisting aside, drops beneath the second, then turns into a spinning counterattack that creates a bright crescent arc of light. <Subject 3> blocks with one wing and black mist explodes outward on contact. Both separate for an instant, then re-engage. <Subject 3> lashes forward again with black mist whips, while <Subject 4> advances instead of retreating, batting aside one strike and slipping past another. The camera uses a controlled lateral Tracking Shot to keep both full bodies clearly readable.

[Shot 6] At 00:10.300, the fight intensifies. <Subject 3> leaps upward and drives downward with a heavy shadow strike. <Subject 4> rises to meet her with wings flaring and catches the blow with crossed light energy. A compact shockwave bursts outward, scattering leaves, fog, black fragments, and golden sparks. As they land, <Subject 4> surges forward with two fast consecutive sacred strikes: the first forces <Subject 3> to stagger sideways, and the second lands cleanly against her defense, pushing her back several meters. The camera performs a slight Arc Shot around the clash to emphasize momentum while keeping the action readable.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.200, the shot cuts to the finishing exchange. <Subject 3> desperately gathers black mist into a final concentrated attack and thrusts it straight at <Subject 4>. <Subject 4> pivots her body to evade the line of attack, steps inside <Subject 3>'s guard, and releases a powerful concentrated golden-white strike directly into <Subject 3>'s defense. Clear contact occurs at center frame. A bright impact flash and circular pressure wave erupt. <Subject 3> is thrown backward, hits the forest ground, and slides across fallen leaves. Her thorn wings collapse partially around her as black mist disperses. <Subject 3> emits a painful hiss and harsh roar while struggling on the ground. <Subject 4> remains standing in a stable victorious stance.

[Shot 8] At 00:13.700, <Subject 3> looks alarmed and realizes she has lost. Black mist suddenly surges around her body, twisting upward in a tight spiral. Within the swirling mist, her figure rapidly breaks apart into shadowy fragments. A sharp dark flash erupts, and she instantly disappears, escaping in panic as the black mist dissipates. Immediately after her disappearance, the environment begins changing back: the oppressive darkness recedes, the cold fog thins and disperses, the tree shadows soften, and warm sunlight gradually returns through the canopy. <Subject 4> remains in the clearing, watching the place where <Subject 3> vanished. Her translucent wings stay half-open. A faint green-gold glow briefly shines from within her chest where <Subject 2> merged, then settles. The final frame holds on <Subject 4> standing victorious as the forest becomes brighter and calmer again.

overall_soundscape:
Begin with soft forest ambience, light wind, birds, and subtle deer movement. When <Subject 3> enters, birds abruptly scatter, the atmosphere drops into a low dark hum, and the fleeing herd produces rapid hoofbeats and rustling vegetation moving away from her through the forest. The restrained deer struggles against swirling black mist. Soul extraction produces a deep magical pull mixed with an ethereal green resonance. When <Subject 4> reclaims the soul, the green spirit streams inward with a bright sacred pull and a clear internal pulse as it merges into her chest. The fight includes fast footsteps, wing movements, black thorn swishes, golden light sweeps, blocks, impact cracks, displaced leaves and fog, one compact magical shockwave, and the heavy fall of <Subject 3>. Near the end, <Subject 3> emits a painful hiss and rough roar before the sudden surge of black mist and flash disappearance. After she vanishes, the low ominous atmosphere fades, wind softens, birds tentatively return, and the forest ambience becomes calmer and brighter.

non_diegetic_music:
Begin with soft ethereal fantasy music during the peaceful forest opening. As <Subject 3> enters, transition quickly into ominous low strings and restrained dark pulses. Increase tension during the soul extraction with a rising sustained tone. When <Subject 4> arrives, introduce brighter orchestral accents. From approximately 7 seconds onward, use fast cinematic percussion and tense strings to support the expanded fight without overpowering the physical impact sounds. Peak when <Subject 3> is struck down, then cut into a sharp dark accent for her black-mist escape. As she vanishes, let the music resolve from tension into a restrained victorious and restorative fantasy cue as light returns and the fog disperses.
